widget_market_health.description: The scored session's market_health row; {} when there is none.

widget_top_of_day.description: The scored session's trade-of-the-day ai_scores row (an object; {} when there is none). sl / t1 / t2 = cmp -1.5 / +2.0 / +3.5 x atr_14, only when both are known.

starting_cash.description: a tenant's own book only (absent on the owner's book)

Error.description: W1-W7 routes answer {"error": "message"}; newer failures the W8 envelope {"error": {code, message, request_id, retryable}} (codes in ops/errors.py).
